summary: Focused retest of the two i18n bug fixes from iteration_7 (Milestone 5 Auth). Both fixes verified in the live preview environment. Backend regression clean (46/46).

verified_fixes.bug: Address list Edit/Delete rendered raw i18n keys (common.edit/common.delete)
verified_fixes.verification: Logged in as customer, added a new address; buttons render 'Edit'/'Delete' in EN, 'Ubah'/'Hapus' in ID, and 'Изменить'/'Удалить' in RU. No 'common.' prefix leak anywhere.

verified_fixes.bug: Profile-save success toast stayed in English after switching preferred locale
verified_fixes.verification: Set profile-locale=ru → save → toast 'Профиль обновлён.' shown (no 'Profile updated.' leak). Set profile-locale=id → save → toast 'Profil diperbarui.' shown (no EN leak).

critical_code_review_comments: Header language-selector state is overridden on any /account reload by the server-side preferred_locale (i18n bootstraps from user.preferred_locale after auth hydration). Not a bug for this milestone, but worth noting: users cannot temporarily browse in a different locale while logged in — the selector effectively becomes a shortcut to change preferred_locale. Consider decoupling UI locale from persisted preferred_locale for anonymous-like browsing.
seed_data_creation: Created one address during test; deleted at end via UI cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_7 M5 auth was 46/46 backend + only 2 i18n bugs; iteration_8 verified those two fixes are live. Note that /account UI locale follows server-side preferred_locale on load (header language-selector is overridden on reload for logged-in users). Address form testids are label / recipient-name / phone / address-line-1 / address-line-2 / city / state-province / postal-code / country-code (kebab-case of Python snake_case field names) with the testPrefix 'address-form-new'.
rca of the issue: N/A - both bugs from iteration_7 confirmed fixed.
